open.title: Graphic Designer
open.blurb: A layout with backbone, a mark you can see from the street, and no patience for a timid margin.

open.title: Copywriter
open.blurb: Twelve words, if you have them. Eleven, if you do not.

open.title: Designer
open.blurb: Makes the rough look finished, and the finished look inevitable.

open.title: Stylist
open.blurb: A look you can smell from the lobby, and a pin for every last hem.

open.title: Client Account Manager
open.blurb: Keeps the client calm, the invoice moving, and lunch on the right side of the bill.

open.title: Talent Manager
open.blurb: Books the face, soothes the ego, and gets them to the studio before the light goes.

open.title: Mail Boy
open.blurb: The chute, the stairs, and the one envelope that is always late.

open.title: Bartender
open.blurb: The first pour is for the client. The second is for the house. The third is a rumour.
